source.author: ov
source.text: Utque animus tumida fervebat ab ira, arma assueta rapit flexumque a cornibus arcum tendit et illa suo totiens cum pectore iuncta indevitato traiecit pectora telo.
source.text_original: Utque animus tumida fervebat ab ira, / arma assueta rapit flexumque a cornibus arcum / tendit et illa suo totiens cum pectore iuncta / indevitato traiecit pectora telo.
source.text_english: And as his mind boiled with swelling anger, he seized his familiar weapons and drew the bow bent from its horns, and with that weapon, so often joined to his own breast, he pierced those breasts with an unfailing shaft.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Drior huic turn regia proles advolat amplexus fraternaque pectora iungens.
reuse.text_original: Drior huic turn regia proles / advolat amplexus fraternaque pectora iungens.
reuse.text_english: Then the royal offspring of Dorius flies up to him, embracing him and joining brotherly breasts.
